title: Coherent tensor comparison diagram with its right-factor limit identity
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit cocone $(C,\iota)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$, finitely presented $F(i)$-algebras $A,B$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and an $F(i)$-algebra map $f:A\to B$. Let $P,Q$ be commutative rings, $Q$ a $P$-algebra, with $P$ finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$ and $Q$ finitely presented over $P$. Put $X=C\otimes_{F(i)}A$, $Y=C\otimes_{F(i)}B$. Given a $P$-algebra structure on $X$ and a ring isomorphism $e:X\otimes_PQ\simeq Y$ whose restriction to $X$ equals $1\otimes f$, there is a directed upper tail J, a coherent P-algebra structure on each A_j, diagrams D,E of commutative rings in the common universe, a natural transformation α:D→E, and equivalences d_j:D(j)≃A_j⊗_P Q and b_j:E(j)≃B_j. There are colimit cocones for D and E and a bijective colimit comparison g compatible with α. Every component of α is finitely presented, and each transition square is a pushout. Under the stage equivalences its left restriction is id⊗f, and the right restriction followed by B_j→Y is the prescribed e composed with Q→X⊗_P Q. No stage component is asserted bijective.

source.place: Tag 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat), proof of (3), construction of Ψ; Tags 00QO, 00DD and 05N9. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02JO and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05N9 on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Identify the prescribed colimit cocone with the chosen colimit by its unique cocone-point isomorphism. Tensor this algebra equivalence with A and B, transport the P-structure through the inverse A equivalence, and conjugate e. Tensor induction verifies left-inclusion compatibility. Apply finite-stage comparison-map factorization to obtain a P-linear A stage and its comparison ψ with the full limit identity.

Apply the coherent tensor-cocone theorem to that stage comparison. It returns diagrams D,E, α, their stage and limit equivalences, the canonical P-linear source coprojections, the global comparison identity, and pushout transition squares. The directed-tensor-cocone theorem supplies the two colimit universal properties. Conjugate e with the limit equivalences to define g; the global comparison identity gives compatibility and the equivalences give bijectivity of g. The upper tail is filtered: it contains its starting index and common upper bounds remain in it.

Finite-type cancellation gives finite presentation of f over A from finite presentation of B over the common base and finite type of A. Tensor cancellation identifies id tensor f with a base change of f, so it is finitely presented. The source inclusion into A_j tensor_P Q is finitely presented by base change of P to Q. The left-inclusion identity and finite-type cancellation then give finite presentation of the comparison. Conjugation by stage ring equivalences preserves finite presentation.

Evaluate the global comparison identity on d_j inverse of 1 tensor q. The source-leg identity sends that element to 1 tensor q because its P-linear source map preserves 1. The target-leg identity therefore gives the stated right-factor identity. Transport it back along the B tensor equivalence. The cocone-point isomorphism commutes with each original leg, so tensor induction identifies the transported coprojection with the prescribed one. This constructs only comparison maps; eventual bijectivity at a stage is not asserted.

theorem exists_tensor_model_comparison_diagram
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    {i : I} {A B : Type w} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) A] [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) A]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) B] (f : A →ₐ[F.obj i] B)
    (P Q : Type x) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    (aP : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A))
    (e : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B)
    (he : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (c.pt : Type v) (c.pt : Type v))
          f).toRingHom) :
    ∃ (r : I) (hir : i ≤ r),
      let J := {j : I // r ≤ j}
      ∃ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hir.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P ((F.obj j.val : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A)),
        ∃ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x}) (α : D ⟶ E),
          ∃ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hir.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              (D.obj j : Type (max v w x)) ≃+*
                ((F.obj j.val : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∃ (b : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hir.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                (E.obj j : Type (max v w x)) ≃+* (F.obj j.val : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B),
              ∃ (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E) (g : cD.pt ⟶ cE.pt),
                ∃ (_hD : IsColimit cD) (_hE : IsColimit cE), IsFiltered J ∧
                (∀ j, α.app j ≫ cE.ι.app j = cD.ι.app j ≫ g) ∧
                Function.Bijective g ∧
                (∀ j, (α.app j).hom.FinitePresentation) ∧
                (∀ {j k} (u : j ⟶ k), IsPushout (α.app j) (D.map u)
                  (E.map u) (α.app k)) ∧
                (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hir.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  let ψ := (b j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)
                  ψ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      f).toRingHom) ∧
                (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hir.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) :=
                    (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  letI := aP
                  let t : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i] c.pt :=
                    { (c.ι.app j.val).hom with
                      commutes' := fun s ↦ ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
                        (c.w (homOfLE (hir.trans j.property))) s }
                  let ψ := (b j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)
                  (Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id (F.obj i) B)).toRingHom.comp
                    (ψ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) =
                    e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)
